title: ID0413413-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R2 312555359053] OCPP router is offline

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0413413-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R2 312555359053] OCPP router is offline CRM:02678000009
additional_info.body:
Dear RC France servicesdigitaux.fr,
There are three ways to reboot the router:
1)IF you do any changes or modification in XF3/XF4 VIA SCB & press SET MAIN WAN TO MOBILE  to save the changes it will reboot the router.
Please make supe any wrong setting in router will disconnect the connection with charger & it will have it's consiquences
2) IF you have remote SSH access of charger you can login in into XF3/XF4 webpage & reboot the router.
3) Hard Reboot the charger from SCB.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sunil Sharma
